items.bench: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Hyderabad
items.caseName: Chanda Athish Kumar v. PVR Cinemas
items.headline: 22 minutes of ads before a film is deficient service
items.text: The Commission held that PVR INOX delayed the screening with excess advertisements and ordered ₹20,000 compensation plus ₹50,000 punitive damages to the complainant.
